memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Allergic rhinitis: persistent sneezing, nasal congestion. Status: active. Plan: start cetirizine 10 mg HS, fluticasone nasal spray 1 spray each nostril OD, montelukast 10 mg HS.
- Obesity: BMI 32 kg/m2, waist 102 cm (>90 cm cutoff). Status: active. Plan: start orlistat 120 mg TID with main meals, diet advice: breakfast - reduced carbs, lunch - portion control, dinner - light.
- Vitamin B12 deficiency: symptomatic fatigue. Status: active. Plan: start methylcobalamin 1500 mcg OD.
Due: HbA1c repeat 2025-07-05.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Skin prick test: positive to house dust mite (3+), grass pollen (2+), negative to cat dander. Interpretation: consistent with allergic rhinitis.

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Follow-up appointment booked for 2025-07-10 09:30 with Dr Karthik Hegde (D04).

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Allergic rhinitis: symptoms improved, occasional nasal congestion. Status: active. Plan: continue cetirizine HS, fluticasone OD, montelukast HS.
- Obesity: weight 92 kg (down from 95 kg), waist 99 cm. Mild epigastric discomfort after meals. Status: active. Plan: stop orlistat due to GI intolerance, reinforce diet: breakfast - high fibre, lunch - balanced plate, dinner - soup & salad.
- Vitamin B12 deficiency: fatigue better. Status: active. Plan: continue methylcobalamin 1500 mcg OD.
Due: HbA1c repeat 2025-10-10.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: Nasal congestion much less, only occasional sneezing. Orlistat caused loose stools and stomach cramps, so I stopped it. Feeling more energetic after B12 tablets.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Referral to Dietetics, Sri Jayadeva Institute of Nutrition, for individualized weight management plan and dietary education.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Dietitian reports patient attended two sessions, prescribed 1500 kcal/day diet with high protein, advised to avoid fried foods, and to maintain food diary. Patient motivated, follow-up in 6 weeks.
